Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/0/Text/18] The study's main purpose is to examine whether mental toughness operates as a resilience resource using general perceived stress as an indicator of risk, and depressive symptoms and life satisfaction as indicators of adaptation. [/page/1/Text/4] Risk was assessed with general perceived stress and adaptation was measured via depressive symptoms and life satisfaction.

sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/2] Furthermore, this study focuses on vocational students who are known to have increased health risks compared to high school students (Narring et al., 2004).
